source_row.rationale: Fever with painful, unilateral or bilateral swelling of the parotid glands (parotitis) is the classic presentation of mumps, a viral infection preventable by the MMR vaccine, which can be associated with complications such as orchitis, meningitis, or pancreatitis in some cases, requiring supportive care and appropriate droplet precautions.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Mumps Clinical Features and Complications
